counters.why: Players specifically report Shuri as a reliable Arnim Zola option; her reach and non-contact pressure give her a practical way to work around his awkward Heavy Attack spacing.
counters.strategy: Create space first, bait Zola's Heavy Attack, then punish only when your Heavy Attack reach and timing are clean. Keep Shock pressure going between safe punish windows.
counters.risks: Zola's Heavy Attack spacing is the real execution check. A node that changes Stun, spacing or damage can make a normally safe punish unreliable.
conditions: Do not force the Heavy Attack punish from point-blank range.
Treat Alliance War reports as matchup evidence, not proof that every Zola placement plays the same.
counters.scoreReason: Direct community matchup reports align with the cited kit interaction; no independent current-build timing test or seasonal ranking is claimed.

counters.why: Hulkbuster is reported as an effective Zola option because his Heavy Attack has enough reach to punish Zola from safer spacing.
counters.strategy: Bait the Heavy Attack, dash back far enough to establish the correct distance, then answer with Hulkbuster's Heavy Attack rather than rushing a short basic punish.
counters.risks: If your dash-back timing leaves you too close or too far away, the Heavy Attack punish can fail. Do not treat the range as automatic.
conditions: Practice the Heavy Attack spacing before using the matchup in a high-stakes fight.
Check the active node package for Stun or Power interactions that change Hulkbuster's normal loop.
counters.scoreReason: Community matchup reports support the spacing interaction; no independent current-build timing test is recorded.

counters.why: Players report Sentinel as a Zola answer, using his long Heavy Attack reach to contest Zola's unusual recovery spacing.
counters.strategy: Build Analysis without taking unnecessary contact, bait Zola's Heavy Attack, and use Sentinel's Heavy Attack only from a range you have already established as safe.
counters.risks: Analysis ramp and Heavy Attack timing cost time; a bad spacing read can still be punished hard.
conditions: Do not assume Sentinel's defensive utility makes an unsafe Heavy Attack trade free.
Re-check the plan on nodes that alter Heavy Attack, Stun or Power behavior.
counters.scoreReason: Community matchup reports support the range advantage; no independent current-build timing test is recorded.

counters.why: Ironheart is repeatedly recommended for Jean Grey. Her Incinerate option supplies useful pressure, while her Armor Up state can provide conditional Reversed Controls immunity.
counters.strategy: Select the Incinerate pre-fight, keep Armor Up active before Jean's Reversed Controls become the execution check, and use controlled pressure instead of overextending into the Force Field.
counters.risks: The Reversed Controls protection is conditional on Ironheart's Armor Up. If it is removed or prevented, the matchup becomes much less forgiving.
conditions: Use the Incinerate pre-fight for this plan.
Confirm Armor Up is active before relying on Reversed Controls immunity.
counters.scoreReason: Repeated community recommendations align with Ironheart's sourced protections; no independent current-season timing test is claimed.

counters.why: Jack O’Lantern is a frequently reported Jean Grey counter because he has Reversed Controls immunity and can Parry non-contact attacks.
counters.strategy: Play the Force Field phase patiently, use Jack's non-contact Parry utility where the current nodes allow it, then build his normal damaging-effect loop once openings are stable.
counters.risks: Reversed Controls immunity does not remove Jean's other defensive mechanics, and node-granted Stun restrictions can remove the Parry opening.
conditions: Reversed Controls immunity is the safety feature, not a license to ignore the Force Field.
Do not rely on Parry when the node package blocks or punishes Stun.
counters.scoreReason: Repeated community recommendations align with Jack O’Lantern's sourced protections; no independent current-season timing test is claimed.

counters.why: Wiccan is a reported Jean Grey option with built-in Reversed Controls immunity and Mystic control tools.
counters.strategy: Use a controlled basic rotation, keep Neutralize and Incinerate pressure available, and continue reading Jean's Force Field instead of trying to brute-force it.
counters.risks: Wiccan's immunity solves the control reversal, not every Force Field or node interaction. Poor spacing can still turn the fight.
conditions: Treat Reversed Controls immunity as one layer of safety.
Check for nodes that punish buffs, Neutralize or damaging effects before committing.
